title: SvgFeFuncR
responsibility: Renders the native feFuncR element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeFuncR.children
inputs.description: Snippet rendered inside the feFuncR element with {@render children()} only when the value is truthy; when omitted (undefined), no snippet content is rendered. The component does not validate or filter the snippet's output, which becomes the element's child nodes unchanged.

outputs.name: SvgFeFuncR
outputs.description: The native feFuncR element in the SVG namespace (declared with the svelte:options namespace directive), created with svelte:element under the fixed tag name feFuncR. Every prop except children is spread onto it with {...attributes}, and the children snippet renders inside it with no wrapper element added.
